N1.s: Искористили сте свих %lld бесплатних катлинга. Наставите у Катлингу и откључајте га, па ће и овај бити сачуван.
N1.back: Used-up have-you all 5 free cutlings. Continue in Cutling and unlock it, so will also this-one be saved.
N1.why: Opens with the first batch's S3 sentence so the same fact keeps its words; 'Наставите у Катлингу' matches the system's continue-in-app choice, and 'па ће и овај' says the pending item is saved without a 'we'.

N2.s: Искористили сте свих %lld бесплатних катлинга. Отворите Катлинг, откључајте га и чувајте још.
N2.back: Used-up have-you all 5 free cutlings. Open Cutling, unlock it and save more.
N2.why: Here the app cannot open itself, so the second sentence is three plain formal imperatives in the order the person does them; 'чувајте' is the vocabulary's save verb.

N3.why: Impersonal neuter 'Сачувано' is how a Serbian toast confirms a save; 'место' is the first batch's word for room (S6), and with no paid places yet the one left is the free one; no final period, as in K1.

N4.why: Clipped neuter participle like S21's 'Искоришћено'; 'заузето место' is what Serbian says of a taken seat or slot, so it reads as full, not as an error; 'места' after 'од' is genitive and right for any total.

N5.s: Заузето %1$lld од %2$lld. Откључајте да се сачува
N5.why: Picks up N4's 'Заузето' so the bar reads as the next step; 'да се сачува' (reflexive passive) tells the person the item they were saving is held and will be saved, in 39 characters.

N6.why: The same button verb as S15, in the singular imperative Serbian buttons take, so the Share sheet and the unlock sheet say one word.

N7.s: Искористили сте свих %lld бесплатних катлинга. Откључајте Катлинг и овај ће бити сачуван.
N7.back: Used-up have-you all 5 free cutlings. Unlock Cutling and this-one will be saved.
N7.why: Same first sentence as N1 and S3; the second is a plain 'do this and that happens', with 'овај' for the cutling the person is sharing right now.

N8.s: Ваш нови катлинг чека. Отворите Катлинг и откључајте га, па ће бити сачуван.
N8.back: Your new cutling waits. Open Cutling and unlock it, so will be saved.
N8.why: 'чека' says it is kept for them warmly, without 'сачуван' twice, which would make it sound already saved; lowercase 'катлинг' for the item and capital 'Катлинг' for the app, as in the first batch.
